statements.status_notes: This DHI package backports the upstream polkit fix from commit 107d3801361b9f9084f78710178e683391f1d245 (shipped in Debian sid policykit-1 127-1) before building. The patch rejects XML policy nesting beyond PARSER_MAX_DEPTH in polkitbackendactionpool.c, preventing the out-of-bounds write when polkitd loads deeply nested policy files.
